item.name: Communal Kitchen Tables
item.location: Kitchen, communal eating area labeled Communal Kitchen Tables.
item.readyBeforeUse: Each table is stable and has no damage that prevents cleaning or use.
item.readyForNextPerson: Every table is clean, dry, stable, and usable. No MOOP is present on, under, or around the tables.
item.ifNotReady: Do not use the affected table. Tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: A table is unstable or damaged.
problem.response: Stop using the table and tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: Residue remains after using the approved cleaner.
problem.response: Do not substitute another product. Tell the Dominatrix.
